news.title: A writing life is not a ‘pipe dream’
news.summary_en: Tony Tulathimutte went from an unhappy career in Silicon Valley to the Iowa Writers’ Workshop. Now the acclaimed writer is helping University of Iowa students envision their own paths forward.

news.title: New space gives UI Department of Dance room to expand
news.summary_en: The University of Iowa Department of Dance has moved into a newly renovated, modern home that provides faculty, staff, and students with updated spaces that inspire learning and collaboration with each other and other performing and visual arts programs along the west side of the Iowa River.

news.title: UI Health Care Stead Family Children’s Hospital again ranked No. 1 in Iowa
news.summary_en: Stead Family Children’s Hospital is again Iowa’s top children’s hospital, and seven specialties are ranked among the nation's best in the 2026–27 “Best Children’s Hospitals” rankings published by U.S. News & World Report.

news.title: UI to gain new resources for rural students through national gift
news.summary_en: The University of Iowa will gain new resources for rural and small-town students, thanks to a $100 million gift from Trott Family Philanthropies to the Small Town and Rural Students College Network (STARS), the national, 32-school coalition the UI helped found.

news.title: AI innovations, expanded health care access among quarterly strategic plan updates
news.summary_en: Check out the latest Plan in Progress. From preparing students, faculty, and staff for an AI-enabled future to expanding health care across the state and investing in academic spaces, the quarterly update highlights the many ways our campus community is building for what’s next.

news.title: Researchers: Parents should combine words with gestures to help their children learn
news.summary_en: University of Iowa neuroscientists find in a new study that the brain waves of parents and their child are synced when the parent combines speech with gestures during instruction. The findings could help improve a child’s ability to learn and develop.

news.title: Advanced computing methods developed at UI could help improve drug development
news.summary_en: Researchers in the College of Engineering and College of Pharmacy are developing advanced computing tools to predict how drug ingredients behave during manufacturing. By identifying potential problems earlier, the approach could make drug development faster and less expensive while helping ensure medications are effective when they reach patients.

news.title: UI celebrates Constitution Day, commemorating the signing of the U.S. constitution
news.summary_en: Constitution Day, also known as Citizenship Day, will be celebrated Sept. 17, commemorating this date in 1787 when delegates to the Constitutional Convention in Philadelphia signed the United States Constitution. UI Libraries has created a helpful guide for how to incorporate Constitution Day materials in the classroom. Libraries also will be handing out free pocket Constitutions on a first-come,
